diagnostics.interpretation: Exploratory projection of text representations; two-dimensional distances are lossy and are not evidence of biological relationships. Neighbors use original-space cosine similarity.

input_policy.duplicate_blocks: Deduplicate canonical identity/label/description text, retaining every native record reference
input_policy.gap_fields: Nonempty fields in terms.iter_item_texts order; original text retained
input_policy.missing_descriptions: Retain native label and identifier; no synthetic definition or curation-note fallback
input_policy.record_order: Canonical identity, native label, then native description
input_policy.record_scope: Every native owner of an accepted matched term; no recursive recognition
input_policy.text_budget: Complete text; encoder must chunk rather than silently truncate

encoding_policy.chunks: Non-overlapping consecutive content-token spans of at most 480 tokens
encoding_policy.document_pooling: Content-token-count-weighted mean of chunk vectors, then L2 normalization
encoding_policy.precision: float32 inference and retained vectors; float64 weighted accumulation
encoding_policy.special_tokens: One BERT CLS token before and SEP token after every chunk
encoding_policy.tokenization: Pinned BERT tokenizer; entire input; no special tokens or truncation

runtime.reproducibility: Pinned inputs, model and runtime; retained vectors and coordinates are authoritative. Cross-device or cross-version floating-point identity is not asserted.

pair_construction.scaling: PaCMAP 0.9.1 distance squared divided by both local sigmas; sigma uses neighbors 4-6
pair_construction.self_exclusion: Remove the query row ID at every candidate rank; retain zero-distance peers
pair_construction.tie_break: Distance, then sorted discussion ID; local-scaled distance, then discussion ID
